sixsense_kw_competitor.label: 6sense keyword group: desktop analytics competitors (Verint DPA, NICE desktop analytics)
sixsense_kw_competitor.play: Route to the UPT displacement sequence for the account's known stack. The hit picks the angle and the timing; the message never references research, a search, or a competitor as evidence.
sixsense_kw_competitor.stakes: An account reading about desktop analytics is pricing the module now. The cost of a slow answer is a renewal that locks the incumbent for another term.

sixsense_kw_backoffice.label: 6sense keyword group: back-office capacity and SLA
sixsense_kw_backoffice.play: Back-office one-idea (the backlog is a timing problem). Customers route to the AM's clearance sheet, never a cold sequence.
sixsense_kw_backoffice.stakes: Back-office budget requests land in the same cycle as the SLA misses that justify them. Whoever is in the room before the headcount ask wins it.

sixsense_kw_wfm.label: 6sense keyword group: WFM incumbents (Verint WFM, NICE IEX, Calabrio, Aspect)
sixsense_kw_wfm.play: The intraday layer WFM never finished, on top of whatever they run. Never a rip-and-replace line.
sixsense_kw_wfm.stakes: A WFM evaluation window is the one time the intraday gap is on the table. After the decision it closes for three years.

sixsense_kw_intraday.label: 6sense keyword group: intraday and real-time management
sixsense_kw_intraday.play: They are naming our category without our name. Lead with the idle-minutes-and-overtime one-idea.
sixsense_kw_intraday.stakes: Teams researching intraday management are usually a budget cycle away from picking something. The cost of a slow answer is a shortlist you are not on.

sixsense_kw_category.label: 6sense keyword group: dynamic workforce orchestration and brand terms
sixsense_kw_category.play: Brand or category research. DWO executive sequence; front office and back office together.
sixsense_kw_category.stakes: Someone at the account has heard the name. The next touch decides whether it is remembered as a vendor or a category.

sixsense_stage_decision.label: 6sense Account Buying Stage is Decision or Purchase (modifier)
sixsense_stage_decision.play: Modifier only. Moves the direct ask from Email 4 to Email 2 and favors Lane A over cohort. Never appears in copy.

sixsense_6qa.label: 6sense 6QA true (modifier)
sixsense_6qa.play: Modifier only. Never appears in copy or a rep alert as a talking point.
